notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: לב i min bel/tingting/wil — Tok Pisin 'bel' i makim tingting na laik

notes.subject: זמתי בל יעבר פי
notes.rationale: Ol i tambu: 'tingting nogut i no go antap long maus' (masin i no wokim) o 'maus i no brukim lo'; YLT i holim fomu Pasal yet

notes.subject: samting nogut
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok 'yu no painim' wanem — Tok Pisin i needim objekt

translation: Yu bin skelim bel bilong mi, yu bin lukluk long mi long nait, yu bin klinim mi olsem gol long paia — yu no painim samting nogut; tingting bilong mi i no ken go lus long maus bilong mi.

tokens.gloss: yu bin klinim mi olsem gol long paia
